momentsTitle: We keep living, and Adam comes with us.
momentsText: Weddings, graduations, Halloween, Disney, the beach, the snow. Adam can’t exactly join in, but we still do the normal family things, and we still include him. It takes extra effort: getting him out of bed and into his stroller, getting his equipment ready, getting him portable. We do it anyway. Life goes on, and he’s part of it.
